name: PIC32MX795F512L
description: Microchip PIC32MX795F512L: a MIPS32 M4K core at up to 80 MHz, 512 KiB of program flash, 12 KiB of boot flash, 128 KiB of RAM, USB OTG, Ethernet, two CAN controllers, six UARTs; the Explorer 16/32's PIC32MX PIM (MA320003).

memory.name: ram
memory.doc: Data RAM at physical 0 (kseg0 0x80000000, kseg1 0xA0000000); the bus matrix's partitions (BMX) are not modelled

memory.name: boot
memory.doc: Boot flash (kseg1 0xBFC00000: the reset vector), the configuration words DEVCFG3..DEVCFG0 in its last 16 bytes

sources.name: hse
sources.doc: The primary oscillator: the board's crystal on OSC1/OSC2 (8 MHz on the Explorer 16/32's PIM)

sources.name: sosc
sources.doc: The secondary oscillator, a 32.768 kHz crystal on SOSCI/SOSCO

register_file.license: Apache-2.0 (converted from Microchip's PIC32MX device pack, Copyright (c) 2026 Microchip Technology Inc.; LICENSES/Apache-2.0.txt)

functional.claims: MIPS32r2 execution with MIPS16e by the M4K core extracted from EmbCC (EIC mode, two register sets, fixed mapping, the core timer); every special function register of the device pack's EDC with its power-on value and its CLR, SET and INV registers; behavioural models extracted from EmbCC of the EVIC (shared vectors, priorities and subpriorities, single- and multi-vector modes, the shadow set by FSRSSEL and SS0), the oscillator (the configuration words' clock, the PLL, the switch, PBDIV, SYSKEY's lock), Timer1 to Timer5 (prescalers, 32-bit pairs), ports A to G (TRIS, LAT, ODC, the change notices and their pull-ups, port B's analog pins) and UART1 to UART6 (FIFOs, persistent interrupts, frames at the baud rate on their pins).
omissions: the ADC, SPI, I2C, input capture, output compare, the PMP, the RTCC, DMA, USB, Ethernet, CAN and the comparators (plain registers)
the watchdog (plain registers: it never resets the part)
the prefetch cache and the bus matrix's partitions

timed.claims: Instruction timing estimated from EmbCC's MIPS32 cost table (ADR-015): 1 cycle, 2 for a load or a multiply, 18 for a divide; flash runs at the core's speed. The core timer counts every other SYSCLK cycle; the timers and UARTs count PBCLK exactly against SYSCLK.
omissions: flash wait states (the prefetch cache hides most once it is on)
interrupt latency beyond the instruction in progress

electrical.claims: GPIO pin-model defaults at 3.3 V from the data sheet's DC characteristics (VOH 2.4 V, VOL 0.4 V, VIH 0.65 VDD, VIL 0.2 VDD, the change-notice pull-ups).
omissions: drive strength beyond one output resistance

provenance.author: EmbSIM

sources.title: PIC32 Family Reference Manual (sections 2 the M4K, 6 oscillators, 8 interrupts, 12 I/O ports, 14 timers, 21 UART)
EmbLinkOs/EmbCC tools/embsim (the MIPS core and the PIC32 models, extracted at commit aa4f10a)
